📈 What moved today, Monday 23 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 rose 1.9% to 98,669, bouncing back after six losing days. Resource shares rose 2.3%, and banks and insurers 2.1%.

🪙 Gold jumped 4% to about $3,672 an ounce.

💱 The rand firmed to about R17.37 to the dollar, and Brent oil fell 2.2% to about $90.55.

What it means for you: a firmer rand and cheaper oil both help the December petrol price.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
